classes.A: Pak / asset mods — baked against specific assets at specific paths; fail silently
classes.B: UE4SS / Lua runtime mods — resolve BP paths and widgets at runtime; fail loudly

classes.D: Tooling / infra — smoke test, rarely rebuild
classes.E: Research — reference only, no ship surface
